svg.title: Dorsal tendon routing on an open and closed finger
svg.desc: Side view of a finger with a dorsal tendon. Top row: rings only, the closed finger presses the tendon onto the knuckles. Bottom row: rings with curved hoods over each joint, the tendon wraps the hoods and stays clear of the skin.
svg.text: Tendon threaded through eyelets, free across the joints
Hood fixed to the link before each joint, arc around the joint axis
Closed: tendon wraps the hoods, never the skin
